text_block_list.text:
On the way back from shopping, I spotted 
Special Week standing on the riverbed. 
When I called out to her—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, <username>! Are you on your way back from 
shopping?
choice_data_list: Spe, what are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I happened to be passing by and 
saw Suzuka-san in the middle of training.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Look, over there... Please look! Her hair 
is glowing in the sunset...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The very first time I saw Suzuka-san, she 
was sparkling just like this...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, she really is so beautiful! I can't 
help but be mesmerized.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, if I grew my hair out too, do you 
think I could be closer to Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Grow your hair out?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Suzuka-san! Thanks for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was just thinking that I'd love to 
become like Suzuka-san!
choice_data_list: You really look up to her, don't you?
You really admire her, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So much! Whether she's running or just in 
her everyday life, Suzuka-san is who I 
admire the most!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Not at all. I think you're plenty 
wonderful just the way you are, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... Compared to you, Suzuka-san, 
I'm still nowhere close!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a beautiful and composed 
horse girl just like you, Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why... wait, ah?! Was I bothering 
you by any chance?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...No, not at all. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're always so straightforward 
with your feelings, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I just act on whatever I'm thinking, you 
know~. People always tell me I'm restless.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And that's even more reason why I want to 
be like Suzuka-san... even if it's just 
the vibe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Is there something about her I could 
imitate?
choice_data_list: I don't think there is anything...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That would be the easiest thing to do, 
desu_ne. Though growing it out will take 
time...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what if I copied her headband or ear 
ornaments instead!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eh... those?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Matching with Suzuka-san in a 
different color sounds so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, matching, huh~ Suzuka-san, what 
color do you think would suit me?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Let's see, next time let's go 
together to find a color that looks good 
on you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Matching feels a little different from 
imitating, but...

Still, chasing her role model, Special 
Week's eyes shone with pure brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Quiet... Understood! Special Week shall 
remain silent!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: M-Maybe we should head back to the dorm...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
S-Spe-chan... That's not it, that really 
isn't it...

She seemed a bit off the mark, but Special 
Week's rich imagination never ceased to 
amaze me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! No way...!
choice_data_list:
You don't have to force yourself to copy 
her...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I know it's not going to be easy! 
But I have to give it my all, step by 
step!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Spe-chan. You don't have to push 
yourself just to copy me—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's alright! This is something I want to 
do!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: B-But...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...First off, I'll grow my hair long! And 
when I'm thinking, I'll spin in 
counterclockwise circles!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And when I smile, I'll be graceful! No 
opening my mouth wide, just a gentle 
beam...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I feel like I can do this! Ahaha, 
I'm getting so excited!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Let's calm down, Spe-chan. I feel 
like acting that hyped defeats the whole 
purpose...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I don't give up, someday, without 
fail...! Allllriiiight! Let's do this~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aim for Suzuka-san! I'm gonna ganbaru!

...Somehow, a fire had been lit inside 
her. No matter how difficult the 
challenge, Special Week would never give 
up.
